title: Chapter 651
paragraphs: Chapter 651
Episode 165. After the Shock (5)
"A contractor of truth... An orphan, especially one with a fate prone to misfortune."
"Stop being so pessimistic, Orgal. She's just a kid."

"I apologize if that was unpleasant. Except for the dragons you know, all the rest to me are like children. Well, the contractor of Azmil, you would have saved yourself, so the misfortune wouldn't be related."
"Why?"
"The contractor of truth can't verify me. It'd be nice if you could acknowledge that."
"Doesn't seem like you dislike it, you mean it's impossible?"
"Yes. It would be better not to even try. The contractor and her young guardian dragon might face an unbearable shock. I'm saying this considering you."
Whether Orgal's words are true or not, I can't tell.
But if indeed testing him could bring serious harm to Yuria and Latri, there was no choice.
"You would agree to indirect verification through Bischel or Marjiella?"
"Of course."
"How about Ziphil's side? Do you agree?"
"...We agree. It would have been better if you had warned us earlier."
When Ronil stepped forward, Octavia seemed to be calming her anger.
Ronil wasn't exactly in her command, but he didn't seem to be in a position she could completely ignore either.
"Consider it as the price for abducting the dragon of truth in the past."
As they started to enter the conference room, the crowd waiting outside began to cheer.
Not only Tican, but also journalists from every country except Hufester gathered. They were constantly drawing their figures and taking notes.
It was not an informal conference.
Although the saints were disillusioned by the broken ceasefire agreement between Ziphil and Runkandel not long ago, they held out hope for this conference because it was directly hosted by Jin.
In the conference room, snacks and simple food prepared by Latri were served. Sandra had been thrilled with the cookie when she visited Beradin and Tican last time, but she had no reaction now.
Surprisingly, Octavia looked astonished as she ate a cookie.
During the short meal, ceremonial words were exchanged, and as soon as the meal was over, Yuria entered the conference room.
Yuria, who had just turned thirteen, had confident eyes, not at all intimidated in front of the world's so-called losers.
"Hello, I am Yuria Alphrion, the censor for today's conference. You may converse freely, and request censorship from me whenever necessary."
"I am Latri, Yuria's guardian dragon. If a situation likely to cause problems in the censorship process arises, I will notify you in advance."
At the bold and cute self-introductions of the two, Jin couldn't help but wear a proud smile.
"So, we are starting this conference that determines the world's fate with a laugh, thanks to the cute orphans."
"That term, orphan, it's been bothering me."
"I keep forgetting that we've come to a world where we can't call an orphan an orphan."
"What does 'orphan' mean?"
Jin had heard the term 'orphan' used by Witch Heluram in the past records of Solderlet.
It didn't seem like a simple metaphor, so he had been curious. He also remembered when Quicantel had said that the term was strangely familiar to Murakan.
"It's literal. It's a term used for those who have lost their parents of life."
"You must know that Yuria is the daughter of Lord Kashimir and Lady Alisa."
At that, Orgal gave a meaningful smile.
"Before the parents who gave birth to you existed, there were parents who made your existence possible."
"Do you mean God?"
"It's an existence beyond that."
"Did Lord Bischel and Lady Marjiella receive such information from Orgal?"
"Yes, they did!"
"Yuria."
At Jin's call, Yuria nodded.

"Lord Bischel and Lady Marjiella, please make eye contact with me for a moment. If it's the truth, a blue thread of light will form between your gazes and mine, if it's a lie, a red thread will form."
Yuria resonated with Latri and made eye contact with the two. About three minutes later, a blue thread formed between their gazes.
"It's not a lie, Brother Jin."
Even if what Orgal said was a lie, at least he had explained it that way to the loyal Bischel and Marjiella.
It didn't seem likely that Orgal would have given false information to them.
"Even if I don't have a contractor of truth, I have no intention of lying, Jin Runkandel. The reason why the world is like this now is because the parents of life have perished."
"It sounds out of the blue. Anyway, it seems to be an entity related to the goal of Kinzel I heard about."
"It's off-topic. For now, how about we reveal the cards we each hold? Let's refrain from using the term orphan in the future."

"I agree. Then let's start with...understanding the damage situation of each force. I'll go first. The Barmel Federation and its allies have no damages except for my injury, and injuries to Lord Talaris and Eyeball Mott."
"Has the Lord of Beegung recovered?"
"Due to internal injuries and chaos erosion, he's unable to fight. I don't know how long it will take for him to recover."
"Miss Yuria, please confirm it."
When Ronil spoke, this time Yuria met Jin's gaze. Naturally, a blue light appeared.

"Gipel lost about 70% of its fleet, and Lord Kadun was seriously injured. In addition, more than three hundred elite magicians, including 27 members of the ghost group, died, and there were about a thousand casualties, but most of them were resurrected through the magic stone. However, it will take two months to recover the fleet."

The damage to Gipel as identified by the seven colored birds was about 50% of the fleet, but Gipel and Kinzelo had fought with Ram for some time after Jin had escaped from Hufester. They lost another 20% in the process.
"You lords did not participate in this battle. But I'm curious. Did Gipel's lord suffer no damage in this battle?"
Ronil pondered for a moment before replying.
"... They were hit. But I can't give you the details."
"Yuria."
"Yeah, just a moment."
Jin requested confirmation, not because he suspected any lies about the damage, but because he found it hard to believe that it would take only two months to recover such a large fleet.
A blue thread formed between Ronil and Yuria.
"It's amazing that you can restore the entire fleet in just two months. It would be impossible with just manpower."
Jin did not ask Ronil how they did it.
Yuria was here to confirm the damage to each force, not to uncover all their secrets. There was no chance that the other party would answer.
"Kinzelo lost about 10% of its fleet and about 1,500 mass-produced experts. I was also hit, but it seems that I can recover in about 3 years without special measures."

"3 years? If you have to settle the score with Rosa within that time, does that mean you can't participate in the battle in perfect condition? Most likely, that's what it will be. It seems that we can't guarantee even tomorrow, let alone 3 years."
"That's right. If I had been in perfect condition in the first place, things wouldn't have turned out like this. You may not know, but she's no longer a human. She's become a god."
"A god?"

"A malignant god. Born from chaos. And it seems that everyone is worried about when Rosa will move, let me tell you something. It will take at least one year for her to make a move. Until then, the world will not be destroyed."
"Still, it's shorter than the 3 years you said you could recover without any special measures. You probably have a way to speed up your recovery when the worst situation arises."
"That's correct."
"What's your basis for being sure that it will take Rosa at least one year to make a move?"

"Doesn't she need a stage of adaptation since a human has become a god? She also needs to supply the sacrifices necessary for the godhood. As you know, Rosa and the Prophet use life, including humans, as sacrifices. Do you know that all the humans in the city of Kalon became sacrifices that day?"
"...I was expecting it."
"From now on, more humans and lives will become sacrifices to Rosa. If we want to reduce that number even a little, there should be only one battle."
"So you're saying we have to strike when we can break the Garden of Swords all at once."
Hedo said.
"Yes, that's right, Jipil's butler. It might be fine to try attacking multiple times if it doesn't matter that humans die."
"Leaving aside the ethical issue, I'm also worried that if we unnecessarily provoke Rosa, the speed of acquiring sacrifices might accelerate and create variables."
This time Octavia spoke, and Orgal nodded in agreement.
"That's an obvious point. But there is something else more important."
Orgal's gaze turned to Jin.
"Jin Lunkendell must be able to fight Rosa one-on-one and win."
The implication of this statement was unmistakable.
"Is that because I am immune to chaos?"
The fact that Jin was immune to chaos was no longer a secret. Everyone saw him directly facing Rosa in the Garden of Swords and not being corroded.
Orgal nodded.
"Because you are the only one immune to chaos. In the current world, the only existence that might be able to kill Rosa Lunkendell is probably you. Unless there is a special means in Jipil....."
"Yuria."
Just as before, when they verified the information about Goa, this time Bischel and Marjiella were verified on behalf of Orgal.
Once again, everything Orgal said was proven to be true.
"If there's no immunity to chaos, even if there's someone who has ascended to Changseong, they can't kill Rosa?"
"If your father could return from the Black Sea right now and participate in the war, things might be different. But aren't you unable to contact him?"
"That's correct."
Jin didn't hide the fact about Siron.
This time Ronil requested verification. Jipil had long wanted to confirm the communication status between Siron and Lunkendell.
Naturally, a blue thread appeared between Jin and Yuria.
There was a moment of silence.
"The burden feels a bit heavy since only I can deal with Rosa. Kinzelo at least has the variable of Orgal's recovery, but does Jipil have no hidden ace?"
"... We do."
"I never thought I'd be glad to hear that the enemy has hidden forces. Tell me what it is. I think this is a question you have to answer. It's to confront a common enemy."
"It's historical manipulation. However, it's a means that can never be realized without survivors from your ally Hister."
Upon hearing this, Jin immediately changed his expression and asked,
"Lord Ronil, does Jipil currently know the location of the Hister survivors?"
